description: RAF / A&AEE / RAE comparative and performance data for the priority 8
notes: Drawn from Boscombe Down (A&AEE), RAE Farnborough, and spitfireperformance.com / wwiiaircraftperformance.org transcriptions

Spitfire_I.level_speed_examples: A&AEE: ~354-367 mph at rated altitude on early marks. RAE comparative: faster than Bf 109E in acceleration and level flight without +12 boost.
Spitfire_I.source: A&AEE Boscombe Down and RAE trials (e.g. N.3171)

Spitfire_V.level_speed_examples: Direct comparisons vs Fw 190: inferior in speed and climb. Out-turns Fw 190.

P-51_Mustang.level_speed_examples: A&AEE Mustang I: 30-35 mph faster than Spitfire VB up to 15,000 ft. Mustang III AFDU: roughly equal to Spitfire IX at many heights, inferior climb to Spitfire XIV.
P-51_Mustang.stall_notes: A&AEE: 92 mph IAS clean / 80 mph flaps down at ~8600 lb

P-47D.notes: Limited RAF comparative notes. Dive advantage clear; climb and turn inferior to Spitfire.

Bf_109_E.notes: RAE/AFDU captured trials already covered in AFDU pack. Out-turned by Spitfire.

Fw_190_A.notes: A&AEE and AFDU on captured aircraft: 20-35 mph faster than Spitfire V, superior climb and roll, inferior turn.
Fw_190_A.source: AFDU / A&AEE on MP499 and others
